Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of COST.
Our gross margin expanded by 195 basis points to 26.6%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 19% to 15% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
We generated $6.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $42.0 billion this quarter, representing 19% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 195 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
